atoms.text: Text A: Cities are wonderful places to live. They are full to bursting with life and action, and, everywhere you look, there is something new to see. People seem more colourful and brighter in cities. Fire engines and ambulances race by, dogs bark and children play. City life is like taking a bite of a spicy curry — intense and exciting.

Text B: Small towns make wonderful homes. Everyone knows everyone in a small town, even the dogs know each other! People greet each other on the streets and in shops. Life goes more slowly and there is less of a rush. Smaller towns have more space and more nature. Living in a small town is like taking a bite of your gran’s crumble — sweet and comforting.

instruction.text: Compare and contrast the texts about cities and towns and select all the correct answers. There may be more than one correct answer.

hint.text: You may have to read the texts more than once to find the answers.
